basics.name: Jane Q. Candidate
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 9 years building distributed data infrastructure. Strong in Python, Go, and Kafka/Flink streaming systems; previously lead engineer on a real-time fraud platform serving 12M MAU. Reduced fraud false-positive rate from 8.2% to 2.1% over two years.

work.name: FinTech Co
work.summary: Lead engineer for the real-time payments fraud detection platform serving 12M monthly active users.
highlights: Reduced fraud false-positive rate from 8.2% to 2.1% (measured by 90-day chargeback rate) by replacing rule-based scoring with a gradient-boosted model on a 200-feature training set.
Shipped event-streaming pipeline (Apache Kafka, Apache Flink) handling 2B events/day, cutting end-to-end fraud-decision latency from 1.4s to 180ms.
Led a team of 5 engineers and ran the on-call rotation; reduced P1 incidents by 60% over 18 months through runbook standardization and observability work (Datadog, OpenTelemetry).

work.name: DataCorp
work.summary: Backend engineer on the analytics ingestion platform.
highlights: Migrated 14 batch ETL jobs from Airflow to a stream-based architecture (Apache Spark Structured Streaming), reducing data freshness from 6 hours to 90 seconds.
Designed and shipped a multi-tenant rate-limiting service in Go (Redis token bucket) handling 240K req/s, replacing a Lua-on-NGINX implementation that capped at 30K req/s.

work.name: Startup Co
work.summary: Full-stack engineer at a 12-person Series A startup.
highlights: Built the initial billing platform (Python, PostgreSQL, Stripe) processing $14M ARR by departure.
Owned the production AWS deployment from launch through Series B; codified infrastructure as Terraform across 3 environments.

projects.name: ratelimit-rs
projects.description: Open-source distributed rate limiter in Rust, 2.3K GitHub stars
highlights: Implemented token-bucket and sliding-window algorithms with a Redis backend; benchmarked at 180K req/s on a single node.
Cited in two Rust ecosystem talks at RustConf 2024.
